confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation anchors. Local prices are COP-denominated and were converted at approximate recent exchange rates, so July 2026 values may differ. Cocktail and wine anchors were set from beer-relative ratios (cocktail about 4x beer, wine glass about 3x beer) because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. The FX value comes from a search summary that attributed it to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page, and a follow-up search did not corroborate the figure. Verify the FX observation against the RBA table before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Colombian and Andean mid-sized tourist cities with similar restaurant and accommodation price levels, such as Bogota and other Latin American cities with comparable domestic price structures. No single named city was used as a direct price reference.
